name: sightrader
description: Landing page and beta waitlist for sightrader.com

scripts.signups: wrangler d1 execute sightrader-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT created_at, email, role, agent_use, markets, source, country FROM signups ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.signups:count: wrangler d1 execute sightrader-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(role IS NOT NULL) AS answered FROM signups"
scripts.signups:by-source: wrangler d1 execute sightrader-waitlist --remote --command "SELECT COALESCE(source, referrer, 'direct') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM signups GROUP BY channel ORDER BY signups DESC"
